summary: Shard the DFlash context projection and optionally draft per vocab shard at TP > 1
details: The DFlash context projection is column-parallel at TP > 1 (bit-identical output, 1/tp of the weight per rank).
VLLM_DFLASH_VOCAB_PARALLEL_DRAFT=1 samples probabilistic drafts per vocab shard with identical draws and verification, without the draft-logits all-gather. Default off.
